newsitem.title: POLAND: Early zloty slips vs basket, 1-day depos edge lower.
newsitem.headline: Early zloty slips vs basket, 1-day depos edge lower.

text.p: The zloty eased against the basket of currencies in early Tuesday trade on a large foreign investor currency-buying order, but dealers said that the Polish unit continued to eye its upside in the near-term.
They said the zloty would try to firm to parity while it was still in the wake of the August 4 official rate rise, but that a strong dollar and exiting foreigners may block its path.

"There is a natural trend toward parity, but a strong dollar may keep this level out of reach at the moment...leaving the zloty free to muscle just higher or lower for now," said Andrzej Fiderkiewicz, dealer at Societe Generale in Warsaw.
